answer: Every identity must emit a public pulse each epoch: a signed receipt of one real job, chained to its previous pulse in a crystal-clear public record. New agents graze in a shared meadow pool with capped payouts until ten pulses build their record. A forged pulse triggers an audit: the 60,000 POA bond is burned, half pays the reporter, the identity is banned 8 epochs and its sponsor loses its slot. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 60,000 = 60,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays 60,000 POA once. The limit: an honest agent whose work goes offline can be wrongly frozen by a missed pulse.
